call_points.text: No numeric FY27 guidance; management expects near-term challenges to continue.
Structural margins improved by 1 point in FY26 on premium innovation and cost savings.
₹86 Cr of productivity savings delivered in the last year, with multi-year savings plans per business unit.
Feminine hygiene category growing 7-10%; healthcare sub-categories about 2-3% with volatile growth.
Whisper Period Panties sold over 10 crore units this fiscal and tripled the business.
Half of all pad users choose the Whisper Nights portfolio; Whisper leads period panties.
Crude prices up 30-50% and resin prices up on the West Asia conflict; supply kept running.
Vidya Srinivasan becomes CFO effective July 1, 2026.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹941.32 Cr, net profit ₹153.13 Cr.
Appointed Srividya Srinivasan as CFO and ED effective July 1, 2026 succeeding Gaurav Bhartia.
On 16 June 2026 PGHH's investor call reported FY26 sales of about ₹4,300 Cr, flat YoY, and PAT of about ₹850 Cr, up 19%, with ₹86 Cr of productivity savings and structural margins up 1 point.

upcoming_events.description: Payment of final dividend of ₹60 per share on or before this date subject to AGM approval

watchlist.text: Approval of Members at the ensuing 62nd Annual General Meeting for final dividend

watchlist.response: Cited evolving consumer needs, high competition and 50+ new entrants in 10 years; pointed to share gains in Nights and Period Panties, without a numeric growth target.
watchlist.text: Bay Capital asked why revenue growth has slowed over 5 years despite ad spend, distribution and launches.

watchlist.response: Said the save-to-reinvest programme funds superiority and that focused portfolio parts show green shoots; no growth figure given.
watchlist.text: Securities Investment Mgmt asked whether the company is optimising for margins over growth.

watchlist.response: Said strategy is unchanged and grow-from-within rotations give continuity; did not address tenure length directly.
watchlist.text: Bay Capital asked about frequent CEO and CFO changes over 10 years.

watchlist.response: Declined to answer, citing unpublished price-sensitive or confidential information.
watchlist.text: Questions on parent investment, manufacturing footprint expansion and buyback were submitted.
